For vulnerabilities, use the private reporting link in SECURITY.md instead. Do not attach real interviews, confidential process diagrams, credentials, or full debug logs containing private paths. Prefer a minimal synthetic example.

### Environment

Tool version or commit, Node version, operating system/architecture, browser version, and agent host if relevant:

Exact command and smallest synthetic request/XML that demonstrates the problem:

### Expected and observed behavior

Include the exit code and content-free finding codes where possible. Describe any manual changes to the generated BPMN or SVG:
